summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the shipped file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled JavaScript bundle using string-array rotation obfuscation (a WV8StW shift routine, a large numeric constant table, hex-mangled identifiers) whose contents are opaque. The package advertises itself as a set of custom ESLint rules; an ESLint rules plugin has no functional need for the Bun runtime or a large obfuscated bundle, and there is a clear mismatch between the advertised purpose and the shipped install-time behavior. Installing the package causes an arbitrary opaque payload to execute on the installer's machine via an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
